description: This Java source file defines the SupplierProductServices class, containing service methods related to suppliers of products in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving supplier information for a product and converting product features for a specific supplier.

classes.name: SupplierProductServices
classes.description: Provides service methods for managing suppliers related to products within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getSuppliersForProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of SupplierProduct entities for a specified product, filtering by various parameters such as partyId, currency, date, quantity, and agreement, and sorting by price.

methods.name: convertFeaturesForSupplier
methods.description: Converts product feature details to match the supplier-specific representations for a given supplier party.
